metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 1994 · Schindler's List
metas.description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce after witnessing their persecution by the Nazis.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1991 · JFK
metas.description: New Orleans District Attorney Jim Garrison discovers there's more to the Kennedy assassination than the official story.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1993 · Tombstone
metas.description: A successful lawman's plans to retire anonymously in Tombstone, Arizona, are disrupted by the kind of outlaws he was famous for eliminating.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1999 · The Insider
metas.description: A research chemist comes under personal and professional attack when he decides to appear in a 60 Minutes exposé on Big Tobacco.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1995 · Apollo 13
metas.description: NASA must devise a strategy to return Apollo 13 to Earth safely after the spacecraft undergoes massive internal damage putting the lives of the three astronauts on board in jeopardy.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1992 · Malcolm X
metas.description: Biographical epic of the controversial and influential Black Nationalist leader, from his early life and career as a small-time gangster, to his ministry as a member of the Nation of Islam and his eventual assassination.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1998 · The Thin Red Line
metas.description: Adaptation of James Jones' autobiographical 1962 novel, focusing on the conflict at Guadalcanal during the second World War.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1993 · Gettysburg
metas.description: In 1863, the Northern and Southern forces fight at Gettysburg in the decisive battle of the American Civil War.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1994 · Quiz Show
metas.description: A young lawyer, Richard Goodwin, investigates a potentially fixed game show. Charles Van Doren, a big time show winner, is under Goodwin's investigation.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1990 · Cyrano de Bergerac
metas.description: Famed swordsman and poet Cyrano de Bergerac is in love with his cousin Roxane. He has never expressed his love for her as he his large nose undermines his self-confidence. Then he finds a way to express his love to her, indirectly.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1998 · Elizabeth
metas.description: The early years of the reign of Elizabeth I of England and her difficult task of learning what is necessary to be a monarch.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1997 · Amistad
metas.description: In 1839, the revolt of Mende captives aboard a Spanish owned ship causes a major controversy in the United States when the ship is captured off the coast of Long Island. The courts must decide whether the Mende are slaves or legal...
